Because I'm on a very limited budget I've tried the budget brands and even "house" brands from well-known stores around the country.  I won't do it again.  These are the highest quality filters, and they're proof-positive of the axiom that "you get what you pay for."  They don't fold over or collapse during use, especially if you take a couple of seconds to press the seam open against the coffee basket before adding the coffee grounds.  In addition, I like supporting quality brands that have been around for many years when I can.  These filters bear the name of the lady who "invented" them a long time ago, and because the standard of quality has not been compromised for higher profit it seems worthwhile to keep supporting the company that makes them.
